description: Pearson classification of Gray-Scott pattern types

pearson_types.name: Uniform Red
pearson_types.description: Evolves to uniform red (low u) state

pearson_types.name: Uniform Blue
pearson_types.description: Evolves to uniform blue (high u) state

pearson_types.name: Wavelet Chaos
pearson_types.description: Spatiotemporal chaos of wavelets and fledgling spirals

pearson_types.name: Ocean Voids
pearson_types.description: Waves on a blue ocean with periodic red voids

pearson_types.name: Unstable Stripes
pearson_types.description: Wormlike stripes with endless grain boundary events

pearson_types.name: Turing Spots
pearson_types.description: True Turing patterns: hexagonal array of negative spots

pearson_types.name: Chaotic Mitosis
pearson_types.description: Spots split via mitosis, rings grow until contact

pearson_types.name: Stable Chaotic Spots
pearson_types.description: More symmetrical and stable than epsilon

pearson_types.name: Spots and Worms
pearson_types.description: Mix of spots and short worms, reaches steady state

pearson_types.name: Ring Growth Stripes
pearson_types.description: Blue spots grow into concentric rings then stripes

pearson_types.name: Mitotic Hexagons
pearson_types.description: Solitons divide, arrange into hexagonal grids

pearson_types.name: Growing Worms
pearson_types.description: Stripes grow from each end, reorganize to parallel

pearson_types.name: Inert Solitons
pearson_types.description: Non-mitotic solitons, drift apart exponentially slowly

pearson_types.name: Spirals
pearson_types.description: Large sustained spirals similar to BZ reaction

pearson_types.name: U-Skate World
pearson_types.description: Stable moving localized structures, computational complexity

pearson_types.name: Red Soap Bubbles
pearson_types.description: Closed red regions bordered by stripes with surface tension

pearson_types.name: Blue Soap Bubbles
pearson_types.description: Closed blue soap bubbles bordered by negative stripes
